market_definition: The silicone pressure-sensitive adhesives market comprises tacky adhesives based on silicone gums and MQ resins, valued for temperature and chemical stability and skin compatibility. It measures sales of formulated PSA used in tapes, medical and electronics. BY CURE TYPE: Peroxide-Cure, Platinum Addition-Cure. BY ADHESION LEVEL: Low-Tack / Gentle, Medium-Tack, High-Tack. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Medical & Wound Care, Electronics & Display, High-Temperature Tapes, Automotive, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Acrylic and rubber PSAs; RTV and heat-cure silicone adhesives; finished silicone tapes. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
